chunks: 601 - Al-Sadiq عليه السلام said regarding the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
"Indeed, salat (prayer) has been decreed upon the believers as a timed prescription."

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام, the one transmitting the explanation
key_terms.الصَّلَاةَ: salat (prayer), the prescribed act of worship mentioned in the verse
key_terms.اللَّهِ: Allah, whose verse is being interpreted
key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the believers upon whom the ruling applies
key_terms.قَوْلِ: the statement or wording being explained
key_terms.مَفْرُوضًا: obligatory or prescribed as a binding duty

ai.seo_question: What does "a timed prescription" mean in Qur'an 4:103 according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام explains that the verse describes salat (prayer) as something obligatory upon the believers. His statement clarifies that the phrase indicates a prescribed and binding duty.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.601 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said regarding the words of Allah (swt),:
"Indeed, prayer has been decreed upon the believers a timed decree" (Surah An-Nisa 4:103).
